jira_import_destination_name_hint: Shown in the sidebar and on the project page.

jira_import_error_reconnect: Jira wants you to sign in again.
jira_import_error_storage: Imports keep attachments in your organization's file storage. Set up storage first.

jira_import_failure_attachments_descript: Everything else is in place. Try again to copy the missing files, or choose which ones to leave out.

jira_import_failure_file_write_title: Files couldn't be saved to storage
jira_import_failure_internal_description: ProjectProject hit a problem of its own and stopped after retrying. Nothing half-finished is visible. Scan the project again to start over.

jira_import_failure_paused_description: The run stopped part way and can carry on from where it paused.

jira_import_failure_project_access_title: Your Jira account lost access to the project
jira_import_failure_project_gone_descrip: Jira no longer has this project, or it was moved. Scan again if it was renamed, or delete this import.

jira_import_failure_rate_limited_title: Jira asked us to slow down
jira_import_failure_response_description: ProjectProject retried for several minutes, but Jira kept answering in a way we couldn't use. Scan the project again to start fresh.
jira_import_failure_response_title: Jira sent something we couldn't read
jira_import_failure_scan_description: Part of the project couldn't be read. Scan it again to get a complete picture.
jira_import_failure_service_description: ProjectProject retried for several minutes before stopping. Scan again in a little while.

jira_import_failure_stalled_description: Nothing moved for 45 minutes, so ProjectProject stopped it. Scan the project again to start over, or delete this import.
jira_import_failure_storage_description: ProjectProject retried for several minutes, but the organization's file storage couldn't be reached. Check the storage settings, then scan again.
jira_import_failure_superseded_descripti: A newer scan of this project replaced this one. Scan again to continue.
jira_import_failure_unknown_description: The import stopped without a known reason. Nothing half-finished is visible.
jira_import_failure_unreachable_descript: ProjectProject retried for several minutes, but Jira kept not answering. Scan the project again once Jira is back.
jira_import_failure_verification_descrip: Everything was written, but the final check found the new project incomplete, so nothing was made visible. Scan the project again to start a fresh import, or delete this one.

jira_import_list_description: Jira projects you are bringing into ProjectProject.
jira_import_people_description: Linked people keep their tickets and comments. For someone you don't link, comments keep their Jira name, tickets assigned to them arrive unassigned, tickets they reported show you as creator, and each ticket's import note records their name. Invite them and all of this moves to them when they accept.

jira_import_reconnect_description: Jira wants you to sign in again before we can read your projects.
